house.name: QuestDuo — The Deep and Dollmaker's House

inn.name: Gamer Social Club — Escape Webdrench Inn

ending.name: Gamer Social Club — Together at Last

zh.goal: 解救 Magda，取得墙壁弹射，开放后续探索。
zh.before: 先检查无限攀爬与悬停，并在沿途帐篷整理油瓶和饰物。

steps.title: 进入房屋
steps.text: 从沼泽西侧过水，继续向左，下行后进入房屋。

steps.title: 沿钟声机关下行
steps.text: 在粉色尖刺通道用火柴敲钟切换平台，向下层第二帐篷推进并存档。

steps.title: 打开支路
steps.text: 帐篷下方右侧可检查墓室拉杆；返回房屋左侧，借电梯和弹射打开上方拉杆。

steps.title: 处理玩偶师之镜
steps.text: 进入镜子战。分身阶段控制会反向，先观察受攻击的半边，再决定移动。详细要点见下方首领入口。

steps.title: 取得新能力
steps.text: 胜利后找 Magda，进入能力巢穴，完成墙壁弹射教学。

check: 离开前确认墙壁弹射已取得。
遇到单侧拉杆无法打开的支路，记下位置，从另一侧回访。

en.goal: Rescue Magda and unlock Wall Sling for later exploration.
en.before: Check Endless Climb and Hover, then review healing and trinkets at a tent.

steps.title: Enter the house
steps.text: Cross the western Bog water, continue left and descend into the house.

steps.title: Follow the bell route
steps.text: Switch platforms across pink spikes with bells; descend to the second tent and save.

steps.title: Open branches
steps.text: Check the Burial Vault lever below-right of the tent. Return left through the house elevator to the upper lever.

steps.title: Face the mirror
steps.text: During the split phase, controls mirror each other. Watch the attacked half before moving; use the boss notes below.

steps.title: Learn the ability
steps.text: After victory, find Magda and complete the Wall Sling nest tutorial.

check: Mark one-sided lever routes and return from their other side.

zh.goal: 护送 Irma 参加聚会，并取得这一支路的金色羽毛。
zh.before: 带上墙壁弹射，准备在墓室西侧持续探索。

steps.title: 从雨境进入
steps.text: 沿午夜雨境下层支路进入墓室；入区后先向左寻找 Irma。

steps.title: 接上护送任务
steps.text: 与 Irma 对话后到附近帐篷存档。帐篷上方支路可查看生锈罗盘。

steps.title: 打开回返通道
steps.text: 沿下层机关路线推进，处理箭陷阱并拉动拉杆，打开连接排水道的通道。

steps.title: 前往西侧帐篷
steps.text: 继续向左穿过上层陷阱，到第二帐篷休整，再从左侧进入掘墓者场地。

steps.title: 完成聚会
steps.text: 胜利后继续向左进入聚会屋，完成护送并领取金色羽毛。

check: 击败首领后还要继续到聚会屋。
可从下方任务入口核对护送目标。

en.goal: Escort Irma to the party and collect this branch's Golden Feather.
en.before: Bring Wall Sling and prepare to explore west through the vault.

steps.title: Enter from the rain
steps.text: Follow the lower Midnight Drench branch into the vault; look left for Irma.

steps.title: Start the escort
steps.text: Talk to Irma and save nearby. Check above the tent for Rusted Compass.

steps.title: Open the return route
steps.text: Continue through lower mechanisms and arrow traps; pull the lever linking back to the Drains.

steps.title: Reach the western tent
steps.text: Cross upper traps leftward to the second tent, then enter Gravedigger's arena to its left.

steps.title: Finish at the party
steps.text: After victory, continue left into the party house for the escort reward and feather.

check: Continue to the party house after the boss.
Use the related quest below to check the escort objective.

zh.goal: 通过旅店机关并逃离店主，取得金色羽毛。
zh.before: 在追逐前存档，并确认能使用滑行、悬停与墙壁弹射。

steps.title: 探索与开路
steps.text: 借泡泡和钟声机关向上探索，操作沿途拉杆；虫翅饰物所在支路也有开路拉杆。

steps.title: 接近访客簿
steps.text: 到后段帐篷存档，再向下与店主互动，触发签名场景。

steps.title: 向左逃离
steps.text: 追逐中连续处理钟、可破坏障碍和蛛网借力点；按游戏提示操作。

steps.title: 检查出口
steps.text: 逃出后进入午夜雨境，向左领取金色羽毛。

check: 羽毛总数未到七根时，先回金色羽毛目录核对其他支路。

en.goal: Clear the inn mechanisms and escape for a Golden Feather.
en.before: Save before the chase and check Slide, Hover and Wall Sling.

steps.title: Explore and open paths
steps.text: Use bubbles, bells and levers; the Insect Wing branch also opens a route.

steps.title: Approach the guest book
steps.text: Save at the later tent, then descend to the signing encounter.

steps.title: Escape left
steps.text: Handle bells, barriers and web launch points using the game's prompts.

steps.title: Check the exit
steps.text: Collect the feather left of the Midnight Drench exit.

check: If you still lack seven feathers, check the feather index for other branches.

zh.goal: 解救 Ilda 的兄弟姐妹，前往女王寝室并完成主线。
zh.before: 确认七根金色羽毛齐全，回沼泽的城堡入口。

steps.title: 入城存档
steps.text: 向入口出示羽毛，继续上行与 Ilda 对话，找到城堡帐篷。

steps.title: 解救兄弟姐妹
steps.text: 探索上下层拉杆支路；一对在银色玩偶场地右侧，另外两对分别需探索下层与上层战斗房。

steps.title: 返回 Ilda
steps.text: 三对全数救出后按目标返回 Ilda，经搭出的路径前往寝室并存档。

steps.title: 应对女王
steps.text: 前段处理地面危险，后段转移到升起的平台。招式应对见下方女王攻略。

steps.title: 继续回访
steps.text: 主线结束后可以补收集；从通关后入口核对 Soar、神秘地图和灵魂碎片。

check: 兄弟姐妹不是一处目标，要确认三对均已救出。
若尚未取得 Soar，先查看能力页的开放条件。

en.goal: Rescue Ilda's siblings and reach the Queen's Chamber.
en.before: Bring seven Golden Feathers to the Bog castle entrance.

steps.title: Enter and save
steps.text: Present the feathers, ascend to Ilda and find the castle tent.

steps.title: Rescue the siblings
steps.text: Check lower and upper branches; one pair is right of Silver Doll, others follow lower exploration and an upper combat room.

steps.title: Return to Ilda
steps.text: With all three pairs freed, return to Ilda and save on the chamber route.

steps.title: Face the Queen
steps.text: Handle floor hazards, then raised platforms; consult the boss guide below.

steps.title: Keep exploring
steps.text: After the story, check postgame notes for Soar, the map and fragments.

check: Check Soar's ability page if it remains locked.
